about: ADR 0153 / ADR 0167 / QRT-297: the only hosts the module installer may reach, on consent. The sole package host is the fixed `index` GitHub release of qrtz-ai/qrtz (direct release download URLs, never the REST API host; a layout path v1/a/b is the flat asset v1.a.b). redirectHosts are the only hosts its answers may redirect to (GitHub's release asset CDN); any other redirect fails the request. root1Sha256 pins v1/root/1.root.json (root 1 from scripts/modules/release-keys.sh, 2026-10-18; threshold 2, both root keys; a public copy with its .sig is checked in at crates/qrtz-modules/roots/ and served as the asset v1.root.1.root.json of the index release). Were it null, every network install would be refused. modelMirrors are the only hosts a signed tree's mirror URL may point at, and since ADR 0171 the only place a model file is fetched from: its pinned Hugging Face URL (a commit, never main), checked by the signed sha256 and size through the same fetcher; the package host serves packages, roots, the index and the timestamp, never model bytes. crates/qrtz-lifecycle/tests/offline_graph.rs checks this file.
